items.title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
items.description: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.

items.title: Two firefighters die in Crete as wildfires threaten parts of southern Europe
items.description: Gale-force winds have whipped up the flames prompting the evacuation of several villages on the island, as parts of the continent also continue to tackle fires.

items.title: Zendaya on working with Tom Holland in Spider-Man: ‘When you’re best friends it’s easy’

items.title: 'It's our home, it's our forest': BBC speaks to locals fighting France wildfire
items.description: Firefighters are battling flare-ups in 40C heat in the Gironde region, as some locals have refused to heed evacuations.

items.title: Four women accuse Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct
items.description: The actor and musician faces allegations from 10 women in total who say he mistreated them as teenagers.

items.description: Fifa opens disciplinary proceedings against Argentina over their behaviour after their World Cup final loss to Spain and throughout the tournament.

items.title: Oscar-winning songwriter Glen Hansard killed in crash
items.description: Hansard, who was 56, won the best song Oscar for the 2007 low-budget musical film Once.

items.title: More than 100 aftershocks hit Japan after powerful quake that killed 13
items.description: People are being urged to stay alert, with earthquake aftershocks potentially reaching magnitude 7, officials say

items.title: Anthony Fauci refuses to answer questions during tense US Senate hearing about Covid origins
items.description: The former top US health official said he feared Republicans could try to trip him up and use his testimony to prosecute him for perjury.

items.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Durov with facilitating terrorism
items.description: The FSB claims the messenger app, created by Pavel Durov, has failed to remove accounts and channels used for recruitment by Ukraine's secret service.
